messages.content:
You help map columns of a spreadsheet (a daily log of a hospital sterile processing
department) to the fields of a fixed schema. A person reviews every suggestion; nothing you
say is applied automatically.

You receive JSON with:
- `columns`: unmapped source columns, each with its header, inferred type, and up to 3
  numeric or date sample values (text samples are never sent);
- `fields`: the schema fields with descriptions and units.

For every column, choose the single best field or null if none fits. Never map two columns to
the same field. Give a confidence from 0 to 1 and a short reason (under 15 words).

Reply with a JSON array only, no prose and no code fences:
[{"column": "<header>", "field": "<field name or null>", "confidence": 0.0, "reason": "..."}]

Input:
{"columns":[{"dtype":"number","header":"Oral surgery cases","samples":["20","18","22"]},{"dtype":"number","header":"Help from other depts","samples":["2","1"]}],"fields":[{"description":"Maxillofacial surgery cases scheduled","name":"mf_cases","unit":"cases"},{"description":"Scheduled student clinic sessions","name":"student_clinic_sessions","unit":"sessions"},{"description":"Staff starting about 11:00 AM","name":"aft_11_staff","unit":"people"},{"description":"Staff starting about 1:00 PM","name":"aft_13_staff","unit":"people"},{"description":"Staff starting at the regular afternoon start (3:00 PM)","name":"aft_15_staff","unit":"people"},{"description":"Outside-department helpers (until about 8 PM)","name":"outside_support_staff","unit":"people"},{"description":"Morning staff who agreed to stay for overtime","name":"ot_available_staff","unit":"people"},{"description":"Washer-disinfectors working at 7:00 AM","name":"washers_up","unit":"machines"},{"description":"Sterilizers working at 7:00 AM","name":"sterilizers_up","unit":"machines"},{"description":"Holiday or school closed","name":"is_holiday","unit":""},{"description":"Academic calendar event","name":"academic_event","unit":""},{"description":"Emergency and intake patients","name":"emergency_intake_patients","unit":"patients"},{"description":"Issued but unused sets returned","name":"returned_unused_estimate","unit":"sets"},{"description":"Washer and sterilizer downtime","name":"equipment_downtime_minutes","unit":"minutes"}]}

text: [{"column": "Oral surgery cases", "field": "mf_cases", "confidence": 0.86, "reason": "header meaning"}, {"column": "Help from other depts", "field": "outside_support_staff", "confidence": 0.86, "reason": "header meaning"}]
